why: These files are verbatim captures of enwiki article 614753 (revision 1380218630) and its evaluator packet. The article's wikitext and render contain a third-party presigned download URL with an AWS access key id (pattern AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}). The accepted Stage 00 test tests/stage00/test_repository.py::test_no_secrets_in_repository_files forbids that pattern in any tracked file, and Stage 00 is not modified. The files cannot be edited: bundles and packets are verified by SHA-256. They are therefore untracked at the current head and kept unchanged on disk for the campaign's prediction run, verify and replay; they remain byte-identical in git history at the commits named below (history is never rewritten) and in the checksummed evidence export. Nothing else is withheld.
restore: git show <committed_in>:<campaign path>; compare with sha256
